data.rationale: The proposal matches the true procedure (open Bridges & Tunnels tolls, open Tolls by vehicle, select vehicle type, view rates) and reaches the same vehicle_type parameter, but it leaves out the facility parameter, gives two vague alternative navigation routes (Menu > Agencies or Fares & Tolls), and has no concrete selectors, so an automation would need guesswork.
